notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): drop question cards answered on another surface
notes.summary: Question cards in the browser gateway now disappear once the question has been answered on another surface such as VS Code, instead of staying visible until the next question.

notes.subject: fix(agent): detect choice prompts from the final message only
notes.summary: Yes/No choice card detection now uses only the turn's final message (summary or last text block) and ignores quoted question marks, avoiding bogus cards from mid-turn narration.
